function.name: fetch_user_image
function.description:
Fetch the user image.

When called, this function pushes a UserImageRequestFrame upstream to the
transport. As a result, the transport will request the user image and push a
UserImageRawFrame downstream. The result_callback will be invoked once the
image is retrieved and processed.

user_id.description: The ID of the user to grab the image from.

question.description: The question that the user is asking about the image.
